list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, November 2026

platinum.missable: Potentially 1 — Positive Mental Attitude (the Chapter 1 balcony meditation)
platinum.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off your trophy save.
platinum.saves: No mission replay and no New Game Plus. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission; the game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.

roadmap.title: Play the story, meditate early, scan as you go
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters in order and take optional missions as they appear. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude — it may be missable). Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars whenever you can: 100% completion only needs 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and the scanning feeds three trophies at once. Character switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, and most of the list opens up once Jason and Lucia are both playable.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist and 70 of 80 challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (work done earlier still counts). It is closer to 60% true completion: 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges and all drone races. This step earns A Long Road, the hardest trophy in the list.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and the one-off clean-up
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count — they have their own trophies), then mop up the one-off feats: the airport jet, the tank, the bowling alley, the cocktail on Ocean Beach and the rest. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx puts the whole list at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, most of it spent on 100% completion.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of the game in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finishing Chapter 1 pops it. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not fire immediately.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2. Both Jason and Lucia are playable from Chapter 2, which is when most of the trophy list opens up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3. The robbery tools arrive in the middle chapters, so the robbery trophies start opening up around here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back to it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list. Attain 100% completion: the checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. It is closer to 60% true completion — you need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, plus all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges and all drone races. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, and most of that time goes here.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in the game. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Check the tracker under Touch Pad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over each one shows how many you have done.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. The 100% checklist needs every range too, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough, and the 100% checklist needs every drone race too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races and other race types all count — it is 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing also feeds the Combat Focus meter — each fish landed adds about 10% — so a fishing session doubles as practice for Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side-character questline — it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which has its own trophy. Optional missions with black icons and pink letters can disappear over time, but side-character finales stay available after the credits.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. A side-character finale — finish Kenton's strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. A side-character finale — finish Billy's strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Yago's timed street race in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass icon and counts — save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. A side-character finale — finish Randy's strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. A side-character finale — finish Tyrone's strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each outdoor spot and it should count twice. THE missable one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony of Jason's house — follow her and accept. That meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save. The last spots need Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. 100% completion only asks for 15 of 18, so this trophy is a separate grind.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game and 15 full sets feed the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — it feeds Whip It Good at the same time.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10, and 100% completion needs 70. They are listed under Progress, Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest paired with a bank vault job — vaults give you a 4-star level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone; getting out of the flashing search area is not enough.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, and Adrenaline extends it. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, but the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — the Rhinos. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run the roads of Leonida — hit one, grab the cash, and lose the heat. Like Hot Together, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk the map; the area counter fills as you cross into new districts, so it completes itself if you cover the state while doing everything else.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this pops along the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A one-off moment: head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. One of the five vague trophies that point to moments rather than grinds, so it pops from playing rather than hunting.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — a one-off stunt, not a grind.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the alley and finish a game — it also sets up Ten Pin, the melee drive-by, if you keep a bat handy on the way out.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength — buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. One of the five vague trophies that point to story moments — it pops when something goes wrong the first time and works on the second try. Unmissable; it comes from playing the story.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? One of the five vague trophies that point to story moments and strange encounters — it pops from exploring Leonida rather than from hunting a checklist item.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a bat or similar weapon from a car, not a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — it adds up on its own as you buy gear, clothes and ammo.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, each with 1 parking spot, bought in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
